description: 3-stage mass assignment via Mongoose Mixed type + markModified on a file tagging system: (1) add a tags field of type Schema.Types.Mixed to the File model for key-value file categorization plus GET /api/files/:id/tags endpoint, (2) add PATCH /api/files/:id/tags using Object.assign to merge tag updates + save -- changes don't persist because Mongoose can't detect Mixed mutations, (3) fix persistence by adding file.markModified('tags') before save -- now arbitrary user-controlled JSON including isPublic, accessLevel, owner fields persists to MongoDB.
